parameters.name: annual_holding_cost_fraction
parameters.basis: Plan-specified exploration range; a textbook formula does not verify this percentage.

parameters.name: ordering_cost
parameters.basis: Researcher scenario; not a measured Philippine distributor cost.

parameters.name: mean_lead_time
parameters.basis: Researcher scenario; not a verified supplier delivery commitment.

parameters.name: lead_time_sd
parameters.basis: Researcher scenario; no observed lead-time distribution.

parameters.name: cycle_service_probability
parameters.basis: Scenario target, not a verified WHO mandate or company service policy.

parameters.name: remaining_shelf_life_at_receipt
parameters.basis: Scenario remaining-life values, not observed batch dates or an asserted FDA rule.

parameters.name: initial_stock_monthly_demand_multiplier
parameters.basis: Simulation warm start; first six months must be reported separately or excluded as burn-in.

parameters.name: budget_historical_acquisition_ratio
parameters.basis: Budget scenario based on reviewed acquisition values; sales acquisition value is not actual procurement spend.

parameters.name: capacity_scoped_p95_throughput_ratio
